name: Aqaba Marine Reserve
description: Tucked into the top of the Red Sea beside Jordan's port city of Aqaba, this small reserve protects the world's northernmost tropical coral reefs. Snorkellers and divers can see more than 150 hard coral species and over 500 kinds of fish drifting above seagrass beds and deeper reefs. Its corals have adapted over some 10,000 years to withstand heatwaves and very salty, warm water.
